skin_type.description: This parameter identifies the primary characteristics of your skin, which can be oily, dry, combination, or normal. Understanding your skin type is the foundation for a proper skincare routine.
skin_type.score_explanation: Noticeable shine and specular reflection on the nose with visible pores along the central face while the cheeks appear relatively matte, indicating higher sebum in the T‑zone with normal-to-drier U‑zone.

superficial_pigmentation_score.description: This parameter measures the amount of superficial pigmentation, such as sun spots, age spots, and post-inflammatory hyperpigmentation (PIH), on the skin's surface.
superficial_pigmentation_score.score_explanation: Brown-mode mapping shows multiple mottled tan macules on the nose, malar cheeks, and around the mouth with uneven tone rather than isolated dark patches, consistent with moderate superficial pigmentation.

visual_acne_grading.description: This parameter assesses the severity of acne based on the number and type of lesions, such as blackheads, whiteheads, papules, and pustules.
visual_acne_grading.score_explanation: UV imaging reveals numerous porphyrin fluorescences clustered on the nose and central cheeks indicating comedones with minimal inflammatory papules or pustules.

texture_open_pores_grading.description: This parameter evaluates the skin's texture, including the visibility of open pores.
texture_open_pores_grading.score_explanation: Cross/parallel-polarized view highlights enlarged pores on the nose and medial cheeks with mild surface roughness but no widespread atrophic scarring, aligning with mild-to-moderate pore visibility.
possible_causes: Higher T-zone oil output stretching follicular openings
Sun exposure and age-related loss of elasticity

superficial_wrinkles.description: This parameter assesses the presence and depth of superficial wrinkles and fine lines, which are early signs of aging.
superficial_wrinkles.score_explanation: Fine lines are visible mainly in the peri‑orbital area under polarized light without clear etched lines on the forehead or cheeks, indicating mild superficial wrinkling.
possible_causes: Transient dehydration of the stratum corneum

jawline_sagging.description: This parameter evaluates the firmness and definition of the jawline, which can be affected by loss of skin elasticity and gravity.
jawline_sagging.score_explanation: Mandibular border remains largely defined with minimal jowling or shadow disruption, suggesting only very mild laxity.

skin_hydration.description: This parameter measures the water content in the skin, which is crucial for maintaining a healthy skin barrier and a plump, youthful appearance.
skin_hydration.score_explanation: Red/polarized views show slight dullness and micro‑lines around the mouth with limited diffuse glow, indicating mildly reduced hydration.

skin_sebum_content.description: This parameter measures the amount of sebum (oil) produced by the sebaceous glands in the skin.
skin_sebum_content.score_explanation: Prominent porphyrin fluorescence and shine concentrated on the nose and central forehead reflect moderate sebum output.

skin_sensitivity_scoring.description: This parameter assesses the skin's reactivity to external stimuli, such as skincare products, environmental factors, and touch.
skin_sensitivity_scoring.score_explanation: Low‑grade erythema around the nose and scattered faint redness without widespread flushing or scaling suggests mild sensitivity.

barrier_health.description: This parameter evaluates the health of the skin's protective barrier, which is essential for retaining moisture and protecting against external aggressors.
barrier_health.score_explanation: Slight perioral dullness and micro‑flaking cues with mild redness indicate a slightly compromised barrier rather than frank dermatitis.

periorbital_health.description: This parameter assesses the health of the skin around the eyes, including puffiness, hollowness, pigmentation, and vascularity.
periorbital_health.score_explanation: Discernible tear‑trough shadowing with under‑eye pigmentation is visible under polarized/brown modes, indicating combined hollowness and pigment changes of moderate severity.
possible_causes: Chronic sun exposure or rubbing causing pigmentation

lip_pigmentation.description: This parameter assesses the presence of discoloration or dark spots on the lips.
lip_pigmentation.score_explanation: Brown-mode and white-light views show darker, uneven lip tone compared to surrounding skin, consistent with labial hyperpigmentation.
possible_causes: Lifestyle factors such as tea/coffee or smoking

vascularity_redness_profiling.description: Mapping of visible and sub-dermal redness, capillary dilation, and vascular congestion using cross-polarized or red light imaging.
vascularity_redness_profiling.score_explanation: Mild localized erythema around the nasal ala and central face without diffuse telangiectasia corresponds to low-grade vascular prominence.

under_eye_vascularity_vs_structural_shad.parameter_name: Under-Eye Vascularity vs Structural Shadows (Peri-orbital Detail)
under_eye_vascularity_vs_structural_shad.description: Differentiation between pigmentation, vascular congestion, and anatomical shadowing under the eyes.
under_eye_vascularity_vs_structural_shad.score_explanation: The trough shows a clear concavity with shadowing plus a faint violaceous tone; findings suggest mixed structural hollowing with mild vascular/pigment contribution.
possible_causes: Age-related fat pad shift creating hollowness

skin_luminosity_glow_index.description: Quantitative evaluation of skin radiance and uniformity under white and parallel polarized light.
skin_luminosity_glow_index.score_explanation: Reflectance appears uneven—oily highlight limited to the nose with general dullness over cheeks—indicating slightly reduced overall glow.

comedonal_density.description: Detection of open and closed comedones visible in polarized or UV imaging modes.
comedonal_density.score_explanation: Numerous discrete porphyrin-positive follicular openings on the nose and inner cheeks under UV suggest a moderate density of comedones.
possible_causes: Irregular exfoliation leading to clogged pores

texture_irregularities_beyond_pores.description: Identification of micro-surface irregularities, roughness, and post-inflammatory marks beyond pore-related texture.
texture_irregularities_beyond_pores.score_explanation: Brown-mode shows mild mottling and a few post-inflammatory marks without obvious depressed scarring, consistent with mild non-pore texture irregularity.

regional_oil_distribution.description: Distribution mapping of oil secretion across facial zones, highlighting T-zone vs U-zone differences.
regional_oil_distribution.score_explanation: UV fluorescence and surface shine concentrate on the nose and central forehead with comparatively matte cheeks, indicating a T‑zone dominant oil pattern.
possible_causes: Warm environment increasing central face sebum

treatable_concerns_summary.description: Parameters showing deviations that can be treated or improved with appropriate interventions.
